messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] kvcache/continuous-batching anomaly detected in prod-gpu-pool-2 at 2248901234. Rapid cache growth + scheduler queuing for mixed short/long requests. Potential customer impact on /v1/generate (increased tail latency and errors). Auto-scaling did not engage. @oncall-sre please pick up.

oncall-sre: picking up. I'm oncall (Devon) — grabbing telemetry now.

Devon: looking at graphs: paging + eviction storm. kv_cache size skyrocketed. quick stats dump:
```
kv_cache_size_gb: 78
baseline_kv_cache_gb: 12
evictions_per_sec: 3200
batch_queue_len: 24
percent_mixed_long_short: 37%
latency_p90_p99_ms: 120 -> 890
error_rate_increase: +3.2pp
```

Carla: noticed `kv_prefetch` feature was enabled in last config change. I'm going to try a targeted rollback on canary nodes and push a scheduler fairness hotfix.

Ben: +1 rollback recommendation. the prefetched window was doubled by the rollout at ~2248898000 which could explain the cache blowup. we should disable it immediately.

Emma: customer reports: ACME and GLOBEX seeing spikes — they've filed retries. tagging customer-success.

Devon: mitigation plan (short):
1) disable `kv_prefetch` flag globally
2) reduce `batch_pad` to 64 and `max_batch_delay_ms` to 12 for mixed pools
3) enable kv cache hysteresis (throttle prefetch when free memory < 20%)
4) if available, route long requests to dedicated-gpu pool for degradations

Devon: applying flag disable (executing internal flag API)...
```bash
curl -X POST "https://config.internal/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"kv_prefetch": false}'
```

ops-bot: Deploy triggered: `batch-scheduler v2.1.7-hotfix` -> canary (2/10). Change: fairness token-bucket + lower max_batch_delay.

Carla: canary metrics (10m after deploy): evictions/sec -> 410, kv_cache_gb -> 16, p99 -> 230ms. looks promising.

Alice: running extra load tests against canary for mixed short/long patterns. initial results show tail latency reduced 60% on canary. (:+1:)

Carla: rolling hotfix to remaining pool nodes now. will monitor.

Devon: rollback of `kv_prefetch` completed across prod nodes. confirming system metrics...
```
post_rollout_kv_cache_gb: 15
evictions_per_sec: 120
latency_p99_ms: 210
error_rate_delta: +0.1pp (near baseline)
```

Emma: Customer updates sent: ACME and GLOBEX notified. CS will follow up about retries and credits.

Ben: timeline notes for postmortem:
- 2248898000: kv_prefetch feature flip enabled (auto-rollout)
- 2248899012: batch tuning adjustments deployed to mixed pools
- 2248900001: monitoring alert triggered (first noisy signal)
- 2248901234: incident-bot escalated; oncall paged
- 2248901302: disable kv_prefetch executed
- 2248901335: batch-scheduler canary hotfix deployed
- 2248901402: hotfix rolled to remaining nodes

Devon: current status: mitigated. handing off monitoring to Eng Oncall for next 4 hours. Carla will own the follow-up. Open action items:
- P0: add guardrail preventing `kv_prefetch` > 10GB per node
- P1: add integration test for mixed long/short fairness in scheduler
- P2: refine alerts to include eviction_rate thresholds and heatmap for mixed traffic
- P3: customer postmortem and timeline (Emma/CS)

Carla: ack. creating incident ticket and runbook updates. tagging `eng-runtime` and `eng-sre`.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED at 2248901450. Severity: sev2 -> downgraded after rollback and hotfix. Incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2248 (internal).

Devon: big thanks to everyone who jumped in. we'll follow up with a full postmortem and rollout safeguards. (will add notes to the runbook).
